01 / ABOUT

Beyond finding bugs.

I test the journey, not just the screen.

I’m a Quality Assurance Engineer with experience performing end-to-end quality assurance for mission-critical FinTech solutions. My work spans digital banking, payment applications, merchant solutions and cross-border payment workflows.

I combine functional, regression, system, integration, UAT, performance, security and exploratory testing with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to help teams ship reliable products.
